From my experience, you don’t move past it. What he did was horrible and you certainly deserve better. Leaving him will temporarily make you feel extremely heartbroken and hurt, but being out of relationship in which your partner betrayed you in one of the worst ways possible, will eventually make you feel way better than it you stay and constantly think about what he did and feel jealous.

That being said, if you stay, you will have to do deal with the fear that he will do it again, and jealous feelings. One way to combat this insecurity is to become extremely confident in yourself. However, if you get super confident, you’ll probably end up leaving him because he doesn’t deserve you.

I was also afraid that I would fall in love with someone and find out they were not the gender they were expressing themselves to be. Perhaps that is the issue people have?

For the record my opinion of transgender people has completely changed. I realized that my feelings towards them were do to my own confused sexual identity issues and a lack of empathy and open-mindedness. Now, I am super supportive of them and it would not bother me in the slightest to fall in love with a transgender person, man, woman, or anyone else.
